QuickLookBridge_PluginDesc: Experimental: use a running QuickLook instance (github.com/QL-Win/QuickLook) for previews. When its named pipe is available, it takes priority over built-in providers and replaces Lertaro’s preview panel with a docked QuickLook window.
QuickLookBridge_ActionDesc: Opens the selected file or folder in QuickLook's own preview window, over its named pipe.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_QuickLookPreviewProvide: Connect to QuickLook through its named pipe and dock its preview window in place of Lertaro’s panel.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_QuickLookBridgeTranslat: Provides UI translation and localization mapping for the QuickLook Bridge plugin.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_PreviewInQuickLookActio: Manually triggers a QuickLook preview for the selected result over its named pipe.
